# ColorTreeFitted

## Summary

The fitted format of the `ColorTree` card, for grid and thumbnail sizes. Delegates to boxel-ui's `FittedCard` (which owns the container queries, size quanta, and clamping) and shows the picked Munsell notation as the title, the hex as the subtitle, and the swatch as meta. Paints with the linked theme's `--card` / `--card-foreground` pair, falling back to the card's night-sky brand when no theme is linked.

## Import

```javascript
import { ColorTreeFitted } from '../components/color-tree-fitted';
```

## Usage

Wired as the card's fitted format:

```gts
export class ColorTree extends CardDef {
  static fitted = ColorTreeFitted;
}
```

Rendered wherever a `ColorTree` appears in a grid:

```hbs
<@fields.colorTree @format='fitted' />
```
